summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by ChipMOS TECHNOLOGIES INC. reporting the results of its 2026 annual shareholders meeting (AGM) held on May 26, 2026. The meeting approved routine items: ratification of fiscal year 2025 earnings distribution and financial statements, a cash distribution from capital surplus, and release of director non-compete restrictions under Taiwan's Company Act. No special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is described. This is a standard periodic report on ordinary corporate governance matters, not a special situation filing.
